cc:Work.dc:title: Large ships in Baltimore harbor fell 40% during the 2024 Key Bridge closure
cc:Work.dc:description: Line chart of large ships in Baltimore harbor each sampled week in 2023 (gray) and 2024 (blue); the 2024 line drops during the shaded closure and recovers by June.
